description: This file contains unit tests for the SugarFieldText class within the SuiteCRM project. It tests behaviors such as TinyMCE editor initialization, error handling, selector generation, and logging related to text fields that may use HTML editors in the web interface.

classes.name: SugarFieldTextTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SugarFieldText, testing TinyMCE integration, error handling, and field setup behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new SugarFieldText object before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after each test, particularly unsetting the 'action' request parameter.

methods.name: testSetupHandlesTinyMCEInitializationError
methods.description: Tests that the setup method properly catches exceptions during TinyMCE configuration and logs the error.

methods.name: testSetupWithValidHTMLEditor
methods.description: Verifies that TinyMCE is correctly initialized when the editor type is 'html'.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutHTMLEditor
methods.description: Checks that TinyMCE is not initialized when the editor type is not 'html'.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutEditViewAction
methods.description: Ensures no TinyMCE setup occurs if $_REQUEST['action'] is unset.

methods.name: testSetupWithDifferentAction
methods.description: Verifies TinyMCE is not initialized when the action is not 'EditView'.

methods.name: testSetupWithFormNameGeneratesCorrectSelector
methods.description: Checks the generated TinyMCE selector when formName parameter is provided.

methods.name: testSetupWithoutFormNameGeneratesCorrectSelector
methods.description: Checks the selector generation when formName is not provided.

methods.name: testSetupIncludesHeightOverride
methods.description: Verifies that the TinyMCE config includes a height setting.

methods.name: testSetupLogsInfoWhenLoadingHTMLEditor
methods.description: Ensures an info log is recorded when initializing the HTML editor.
